verdict.rationale: ChatGPT's Advanced Voice Mode is documented as enabling real-time spoken conversation ('Tap the soundwave icon to have a real-time convo on the go') and ChatGPT Voice lets users talk through ideas and coordinate tasks in Chat/Work/Codex without switching back to typing. This is first-party docs coverage but lacks independent hands-on corroboration of voice quality/latency. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the voice experience's naturalness and reliability.
